content:
sam: Heads-up — Orchid Health procurement wants: SOC2 evidence (cover page ok), an ISO excerpt, and a signed pen-test attestation they can attach to their vendor portal. they also requested permission to run an unauthenticated external scan against our staging. who can own this?
rachel: I can draft the attestation. our standard is a one-page signed attestation that confirms scan cadence and redaction policy. does Orchid want the full report or just the attestation?
sam: procurement said "attestation preferred; redacted report optional." they'd also like a small note stating we do monthly external scans.
diego: scanning policy: we can allow a scheduled unauthenticated scan against a single hostname. need formal scope (host list + ports) and 72h notice for firewall config. no creds, no internal IPs. kill-switch contact required.
ops-bot: Attestation template uploaded: https://redwood-internal.s3.amazonaws.com/templates/poc_pen_attestation.docx (SSO access)
legal-bot: quick note — we don't sign customer-provided liability language. we can review their PDF and either propose redlines or ask them to accept our attestation.
rachel: checklist I'll produce: 1) SOC2 cover page (PDF) 2) ISO27001 excerpt (PDF) 3) signed pen-test attestation (PDF) 4) redaction rules summary 5) allowed targets + time window + kill-switch contact. include data retention statement for POC staging (logs retained <=7 days).
sam: timeline: Orchid wants everything by EOD Wednesday to keep procurement on track. feasible?
diego: If shared staging is fine -> yes with 72h lead. Dedicated isolated staging -> extra cost and ~5 business days. please ask them which they expect.
rachel: upload rules: do NOT send reports over email. use presigned S3 URL or place into the secure evidence drive (SAML-protected). if they cannot, open support ticket for temporary SSO share.
sam: ok assigning: rachel -> attestation + files; diego -> schedule & scope validation; legal-bot -> review if customer sends their PDF. I'll tell procurement the earliest full-ready date depends on staging choice. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder: attach signed attestation PDF to ticket #VR-9911 when complete.
